children.value: vicāra evaṃ viduṣā saṃvartena kṛtaḥ purā
chāndasatvāt kutsitāni kutsanaiḥ iti samāso nāśritaḥ
he he hatendriyagaṇāḥ kiṃ me bodhāya neha vaḥ
rūpāṇi manaso yūyaṃ jaḍā eva kilādhamāḥ
bhītaḥ pāntha ivāhibhyaḥ pukkasebhya iva dvijaḥ
śveva vyarthamanarthāya maivaṃ vihara he jagat
mithyaiva jātā duḥkhāya na satyā satyavarjitā
na kiṃcidapi mūrkha tvaṃ kiṃ vyarthaṃ taralāyase
na kartā tvaṃ na bhoktā tvaṃ jaḍo'syanyena bodhyase
kastvaṃ bhavasi bhogānāṃ ke vā bhogā bhavanti te
mayā te hi pramārjyete śṛṇu yuktyā kathaṃ śanaiḥ
acetanatve tu ayatnenaiva kartṛtvādikaṃ pramārjituṃ śakyamityāha - yatheti
jīvasīcchasi haṃsi tvaṃ vṛthā yāsi vivalgasi
kriyate yattu yacchaktyā tattenaiva kṛtaṃ bhavet
lunāti dātraṃ puṃśaktyā lāvakaḥ procyate pumān
hanyate yastu yacchaktyā sa tenaiva hato bhavet
nihanti khaḍgaḥ puṃśaktyā hantaiva procyate pumān
pīyate yastu yacchaktyā pītaṃ tenaiva tadbhavet
pātreṇa pīyate pānaṃ pātā yastūcyate naraḥ
tasmānmṛtaṃ tvaṃ mūḍhaṃ tvaṃ nāsi tvaṃ paramārthataḥ
na tvamasti na dehosti brahmāstīha mahatsphurat
ahaṃ tvidamahaṃ tanma iti vyarthaṃ kimīhase
asadvapuḥ kiṃ sphurati śaśaśṛṅgeṇa ko hataḥ

tadbālaśarīrasaṃbandhi
krīḍopakaraṇādi vṛddhaśarīrasaṃbandhiputrapautrādi ca me mama iti vyartha
kimīhase
tena mūḍha na kartṛtvaṃ na bhoktṛtvaṃ tavāpi hi
tadevāsi paraṃ brahma tyaja maurkhyaṃ bhavātmavān
na khaḍge sujaḍe citta sarvāṅgeṣvapi śaktatā
tasmānnāsi sakhe kartṛ mā vyarthaṃ duḥkhabhāgbhava
parārthaṃ kleśitā mūrkha prākṛteṣu na śobhate
īśvaro nedṛśaḥ śocyo yastvayā sadṛśo bhavet
ataḥ pariśeṣādīśvarasyārthe tvatpravṛttirvācyā tatra tūktamevottaramityāha akṛtrimāvabhāsena sarvagena cidātmanā
tvādṛśasya tu dṛṣṭyaiva kṣubdhatā jāyate mudhā
ātmanā saha saṃbaddhaṃ cetaḥ kartrasi sundara
kiṃtu nāsyāsi saṃbandhi kusumasya yathā phalam
saṃvidaścyavanaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṃvido mā cyuto bhava
kīdṛśī kartṛtā citta puṣpaṃ vyomni kathaṃ bhavet
kalanārahite deve dehe manasi vā jaḍe
